name: lalog
description: Local-first work session tracker with automatic event capture, human session descriptions, and optional opencode-powered AI assistance.

lalog.dataDir.description: Directory where LaLog stores its data. Tilde expands to home. Useful to point at a synced path for Remote-SSH setups.

lalog.describeAfterMinutes.description: Active minutes after which LaLog prompts for a session description checkpoint.

lalog.wrapAfterMinutes.description: Active minutes after which LaLog prompts to wrap the session (3.5h).

lalog.graceMinutes.description: Extension length when choosing 'Extend' on the wrap prompt.

lalog.maxGraceExtensions.description: Max free 'Extend' choices before a description is required to continue.

lalog.idleGapMinutes.description: Gap between events that still counts as continuous active work. Tune to how often you touch VS Code while working (default 15 min).

lalog.idleConfirmAfterMinutes.description: After this many idle minutes, ask 'Are you still there?' — lets you keep the session running (and count the time as outside-VS-Code work) or end it.

lalog.startDescriptionAfterMinutes.description: Offer the optional on-start description this many minutes into a session (instead of immediately), only if you haven't added one yet.

lalog.progressAfterMinutes.description: Active minutes between periodic progress-update prompts, which add timestamped notes to the current session (e.g. hourly).

lalog.askDescriptionOnStart.description: Ask for a short description when a session starts, recorded as the session description and a timestamped note.

lalog.autoEndAfterIdleMinutes.description: Idle time after which a session auto-closes (2h). Sessions are not day-bound; this is the only boundary.

lalog.resumeWindowMinutes.description: Recovery: if last activity was within this window on restart, offer resume.

lalog.debugTimeScale.description: Divide all time thresholds by this factor. Set 60 to test a '4-hour' session in 4 minutes.

lalog.redactPatterns.description: Regex patterns redacted from logged terminal commands.

lalog.ai.enabled.description: Enable optional AI assistance via the local opencode CLI. OFF by default — LaLog stays fully functional and local without it.

lalog.ai.model.description: Model ID used for AI assistance. Pinned to opencode/big-pickle by default. Note: big-pickle is a cloud-hosted OpenCode Zen model, currently free for a limited time, during which collected data may be used to improve the model.

lalog.ai.opencodePath.description: Path to the opencode CLI binary. Resolved from PATH if left as 'opencode'.

lalog.ai.timeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for a single AI request.

lalog.ai.maxRetries.description: Retries on transient AI errors (rate limits, 5xx).

lalog.ai.data.sendCommitSubjects.description: Send commit subjects (never diffs or bodies) to the AI. File paths and edit/save counters are always sent; file contents and terminal output are never sent.
